verdict.rationale: Self-service subscription management is a fair question for a subscription-management platform like RevenueCat, so the axis applies. The pack only shows purchase flows (purchase(package:), Paywalls, Web SDK selling subscriptions) and server-side admin actions, which are adjacent features. Nothing documents a hosted portal or embeddable components that let customers upgrade, downgrade, or cancel on their own.

support.subject: As a founder, my customers can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel themselves through a hosted portal or embeddable components, without a support ticket
